disagreementsAndQuestions.topic: Exact end of unclosed brace group in padded table cell
disagreementsAndQuestions.independentInterpretation: LEX-5/LEX-8 say the group ends at the inline-container boundary. Engine tableCell ends at UTF-16 offset 74 while its last text leaf ends at 73. This report uses [56,74), raw "{implements:REQ-1 " including cell padding and excluding the next pipe.
disagreementsAndQuestions.question: Confirm whether table-cell padding belongs to the recovered malformed group. If authored annotations stop at 73, packet wording should explicitly define eligible-inline-content boundary or retain cell-boundary end 74; the reference in the next cell is independently O2 in either interpretation.
disagreementsAndQuestions.impact: Exact malformed diagnostic/exclusion endpoint needs reconciliation; semantic facts/owners are otherwise determinate.

comparisonRequired: Read this frozen report first, then compare every case with authored annotations and the other independent report; reconcile exact ranges and any semantic disagreement before gate approval.
deferredBoundary: No production changes, complete API DTO expansion, runtime checks or pilot measurements are required for this independent pass.
coordinateConvention: Every range is [zero-based UTF-16 start, exclusive UTF-16 end] in the exact original source. Raw snippets identify original text; CRLF is not normalized.
